parameters.prompt: Create exactly ONE full-body transparent PNG game sprite, native square at least 1024x1024. Image1 is original identity, Image2 primary paint/material style, Image3 fixed same-direction standing/proportions/equipment anchor. Match all identity and detail: 08 alchemy prodigy boy, huge round head, short stout child limbs, chestnut high topknot/teal gold cap/golden ribbons, orange-gold embroidered robe with teal lapels and panels, white baggy pants, teal/gold boots. HIS RIGHT hand holds bronze/teal yin-yang cauldron, HIS LEFT hand glass green potion bottle; back herbal basket with ivory scrolls, berries, green herbs and tassels. Keep equipment and head sizes, camera, perspective, character scale, no redesign. Bright polished hand-painted chibi volume. All head, boots and equipment fit in transparent margins, character height 84% square, ground contact baseline y=92%. True transparent alpha background, no colored outline, no ground/shadow/effect/text/grid. Single walking pose, not a sheet, no extra limbs. Both legs must be newly drawn for the specified biomechanical phase. Pelvis fixed over support zone, small natural stride with no running or floating. Direction W: EXACT LEFT SIDE PROFILE, nose points horizontally left, one eye visible, no front or rear three-quarter angle. Near visible arm is HIS LEFT hand with potion bottle; far HIS RIGHT hand with cauldron reaches forward screen-left behind/above potion arm with natural overlap, never swap their hands. Basket on his back at screen-right.  Walking phase 04 FAR RIGHT TOE-OFF. Image4 preceding frame03 is the exact continuation reference. Keep the NEAR LEFT leg planted flat almost vertically under belly x43%, ground y93%. Near left thigh/boot is larger, closest to viewer, in front. FAR RIGHT leg trails screen-right and is partly hidden by near left thigh at crotch. Bend the FAR RIGHT knee backwards; raise its heel and then its toe, so the FAR RIGHT boot at x61%, bottom y89%, is fully lifted behind the body. Right boot points down-left, ankle behind pelvis. Crucial: both the lifted far right KNEE and FOOT must still be BEHIND the planted near left leg, screen-right, never in front/screen-left. Do NOT make a forward kick. Keep same camera, proportions and upper equipment. New real pose, transparent background, full body.
